subject: Social Studies
stem: This ruler briefly interrupted Mughal rule (defeating Humayun) to establish his own administration, remembered for building the Grand Trunk Road, introducing a stable silver currency (the 'rupiya'), and organising an efficient land-revenue system later adapted by the Mughals. He was:
explanation: Sher Shah Suri (1540-45) briefly displaced Humayun, and despite his short reign is renowned for major administrative reforms — the Grand Trunk Road, a standardised silver rupee, and a systematic land-revenue survey — many of which Akbar's later administration built upon.
